card.name: Spaces before numbers in sexual-health labels
card.fires_on: The space or small linking word right before a number or next term, in erectile-dysfunction and sexual-health drug labels. Examples are 'greater than' before 4 hours or 3 units, and commas before reference numbers.

modes.label: Space before a number
modes.description: A blank space just before a quantity or section number, such as after 'greater than' or a comma in a reference list.

modes.label: Linking word in desire or sex text
modes.description: A small word like 'and' or 'using' joining items in text about sexual desire or sexual risk.
modes.example: Patients may decide the optimal time for VYLEESI administration based on how they experience the duration of effect on desire<< and>> any adverse reactions such as nausea

card.writes: It suppresses sexual words such as sexual, sexuality and erotic, so it steers the model away from sexual vocabulary at these spots.
card.plain: It fires on the gap before a number in erection and sexual-function drug labels, and it holds back sexual words there.
